engineeringSkip.reason: This is a speculative buzzword mash-up — there is no scientific basis for 'cryptographic proofs of consciousness' or for hashing neural firing patterns as a verifiable identity.

factCheck.reason: There is no measurable 'signature' of consciousness to hash — brain activity changes every moment and with every thought, so no cryptographic proof of an unaltered mind can exist, making this a mash-up of buzzy terms rather than an engineering plan.
